stem.text: When descending Group 17 from chlorine to iodine, which statement is correct?

A.text: The hydrides become less thermally stable as they become weaker reducing agents.

B.text: The hydrides become more thermally stable as the reactivity of the elements decreases.

C.text: The volatility of the elements decreases as the van der Waals’ forces increase.

D.text: The volatility of the elements increases as the size of the molecules increases.
